subject: Visitor lane shift / keycard provisioning / arrival queueing plan
messages:
From: Julian Park <julian@clearday.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite immersion for Clearday — preliminary timing and constraints

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for making room for a Clearday immersion at Redwood HQ. We have a cohort of 18 clinical ops and product folks looking to visit June 4 (preferred) or June 11 (backup). A couple of things popped up on our side I wanted to flag early:

- Several attendees will carpool from the South Bay — it'd be very helpful to confirm visitor parking and any shuttle / drop-off guidance.
- We heard there might be construction at the main lobby entrance that day. If there are lane closures or alternate entrances, please let us know so we can plan vehicle drop-off windows.
- We can sign NDAs in advance; please send a DocuSign if possible so we can pre-clear badges.

Attached is a rough attendee list (names only) and a preliminary agenda. We'll lock the exact headcount by next Thursday.

Appreciate your help coordinating logistics — Julian

--
Julian Park
Events & Partnerships, Clearday Health
julian@clearday.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Pre-Visitor-List.csv (csv)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Julian Park <julian@clearday.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 May 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite immersion for Clearday — preliminary timing and constraints

Hi Julian —

Thanks for the heads-up. June 4 is doable; June 11 we also have seats but prefer the 4th. A couple of operational notes based on your items:

- Construction: the main lobby turnaround will be reduced that week for external loading (city permits). We will use "Visitor Lane B" (east entrance) for drop-offs. It's a slight detour but has a covered drop-off and a short walk to the concierge desk.
- Staggered arrival windows: to avoid a bottleneck at the concierge and badging desk, can you split arrivals into two windows? 08:30–09:00 (10 people) and 09:15–09:45 (8 people).
- Badges / NDAs: please have attendees complete the NDA via DocuSign by EOD May 27. I'll send the DocuSign now and Monica will pre-provision keycards for anyone who completes it.
- Parking: we can reserve 3 short-term visitor stalls near Visitor Lane B for drivers and a larger shuttle drop area near Lot C.

I've put Monica on Cc — she'll own keycard provisioning and the concierge handoff. Also attaching a quick site map showing the alternate lane and concierge flow.

If that stagger works, I'll finalize room assignments (two adjacent conference rooms + small breakout).

Best,
Tessa
Director, Field Events & Immersions
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0227

Attachments: Proposed-Site-Map.png (png)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Julian Park <julian@clearday.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite immersion for Clearday — preliminary timing and constraints

Hi team,

Quick operational checklist and next steps from Facilities / Concierge: 

- Keycards: Please send the full name, email, and mobile number list (as in the attached CSV) by May 26. We'll push profiles to the badge system and enable same-day temporary keycards for anyone who completes the DocuSign NDA.
- Concierge handoff: On arrival, visitors should check in at Visitor Lane B concierge. Concierge will radio security to open the internal corridor so walk time is ~3 minutes.
- Shuttle / Carpool parking: We can hold Lot C (10 spots) for shuttle vehicles with signage pointing to Visitor Lane B. For private cars, we recommend the two short-term stalls nearest the east gate for quick drop-off.
- Overflow seating: if check-in runs long, we can stage the Osborn lounge (first floor) with coffee and name tags to keep the schedule flowing.

Note: the keynote room (Conf Room 2A) is AV-intense — if you need Mic+room-recording, confirm by May 28 so we can staff AV.

Monica
Operations Program Manager
Redwood Inference
